result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description. It's set at creation and comes back from all six listing and lookup methods you named. The full suite passes (608 tests, `BUILD SUCCESS`). Nothing is committed.

What changed:

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null. The existing 5-argument method is kept as an overload that passes null, so the ~40 existing callers are unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The six promotion queries (`findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion`, `listUnusedPromotions`) select it and map it into the record.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `returnsDescriptionWithPromotionOrNullWhenNoneGiven` test. It checks the SUMMER description through each listing and lookup, and that promotions created without one return null. I also changed the test's setup to keep a reference to the `DataStore`, so it can call `findBestPromotion` and `findPromotionByCode` directly.

I did not add descriptions to the demo data in `DemoScenario`.
